tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every surface — warm paper in light, deep evergreen-black in dark. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the interview stage and inputs. Ground for `ink`, `ink-muted` and every `signal-*` text.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: résumé excerpts, code-like quotes, table stripes, the track of a progress bar. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges that separate, but never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunk`, `evergreen-soft`, `persimmon-soft` and `marigold`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — captions, metadata, hints — on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: evergreen
tokens.usage: The hiring side's colour: primary actions and selected states in the Talent Acquisition workspace, the Turn mark's asking half. Also text and icons on `surface`/`surface-raised` (≥7:1).

tokens.name: on-evergreen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `evergreen` fill.

tokens.name: evergreen-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet evergreen fill: selected rows, the TA side of a split, hover on quiet buttons. Holds `ink` or `evergreen` text.

tokens.name: persimmon
tokens.usage: The candidate's colour: the one primary action on a candidate screen, the Turn mark's answering half, live 'recording' state. Fill only in light — for persimmon text use `persimmon-ink`.

tokens.name: on-persimmon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `persimmon` fill.

tokens.name: persimmon-ink
tokens.usage: Persimmon as text or icon on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `persimmon-soft` (≥4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: persimmon-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint behind candidate encouragement, the current question's step, and the 'your answer' area. Holds `ink` or `persimmon-ink`.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Highlighter: the one phrase in a résumé excerpt that a question was built from. Small areas only; text on it is always `ink` (light value).

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text on a `marigold` highlight, in both themes.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Identity tint for illustration blocks and the cover. Not a UI surface; never behind body text.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: 'Strong evidence' signal: filled-disc glyph + the word. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red/green contrast against `signal-gap`.

tokens.name: signal-watch
tokens.usage: 'Worth probing' signal: half-disc glyph + the word. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: signal-gap
tokens.usage: 'Not evidenced yet' signal: ring glyph + the word. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Never used to mean 'reject'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces in both themes).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and the candidate welcome screen. One per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Tell us about a time you shipped under pressure.
styles.usage: The live interview question on the candidate stage; page titles in marketing.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: What did you change after the Q3 migration slipped?
styles.usage: A generated interview question wherever it is quoted — in an InsightCard, a question list, a report.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and page headings inside the product.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, candidate names, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Led a four-person team through a payments migration.
styles.usage: Default reading text in both workspaces.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Answer in your own words. There's no timer on thinking.
styles.usage: Dense TA tables, hints, secondary descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above a block; never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Verbatim résumé excerpts, IDs, timestamps, counts in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-word gap in a Signal; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related inline items; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding ×1 (with 20px sides); tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between stacked elements; compact card padding in TA tables.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page; candidate-stage padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections; candidate-stage padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; top of the candidate welcome screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, Signal chips' inner glyph wells, table cells with fills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards — soft, not bubbly.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The candidate interview stage and large modal sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Signal chips and step dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that float above `surface`: the interview stage, popovers. Most cards use a `line` border instead.
